title: Part 10 — Data Protection, Privacy & PII Masking Verification
description: Validates data classification, automated PII masking, cryptographic data erasure, and encryption standards.

assertions.name: assert_data_classification_tier_enforcement
assertions.message: 4-tier data classification (Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted) tags enforced across pipeline

assertions.name: assert_pii_detection_and_masking_accuracy
assertions.message: SSNs, credit card numbers, emails, phone numbers, and addresses masked with 100% precision before LLM ingestion

assertions.name: assert_retention_ttl_and_cryptographic_erasure
assertions.message: Expired temporary document artifacts purged automatically via cryptographic shredding (Zero residual traces)

assertions.name: assert_encryption_cipher_standards
assertions.message: Enforces TLS 1.3 in-transit and AES-256-GCM at-rest with automatic KMS envelope key rotation
